basis: Explicit parent/user-authorized new mode plus three original committed contracts and baseline code; no new WIP contract/implementation read.

rows.given: No new mode, original CURRENT_PREPARATION, new explicit LOCAL_DEMO_CURRENT_PREPARATION, unknown/partial/mismatched configuration.
rows.must: Keep default/old CURRENT_PREPARATION/native/isolated/formal mutual exclusions unchanged. Only the new explicit mode may require the complete existing LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DEMO profile+strict config and exact matching dependencies; missing/unknown combinations reject before business work.
rows.must_not: Never turn ordinary CURRENT_PREPARATION into automatic demo mode, select authority from an event/profile string, or catch an old rejection and fallback.

rows.given: The combined app is explicitly selected.
rows.must: Require exact OrdinaryCaseStepAssignments plus exact LocalSyntheticDemo, LocalDemoCatalog and LocalDemoSelector; same actual Store and the same catalog object throughout the bound dependency graph. Revalidate object/store/provider relation on relevant entry/final boundary, and reject replaced/subclass/isolated/mixed objects.
rows.must_not: No generic allow_local boolean, marker or class-name trust; no arbitrary catalog bypass, Native bridge/permit/writer or formal/isolated provider coexistence. API DI alone is insufficient if _unmixed remains broader or becomes indiscriminately weaker.

rows.given: Existing pinned synthetic pack/journal/catalog/database are supplied.
rows.must: Keep original bounded strict regular absolute file reads, hash pins, journal privacy/input-only meaning, database binding, exact schema32, pack validity, SYNTHETIC catalog content+xmin and parent owner/reviewer/park/org checks current. Startup never migrates, seeds, repairs, publishes or issues identities/Grants/Run assignments.
rows.must_not: The pack/journal/launch state is not approval/publication/Grant/permit; do not fabricate input sources, ignore DB/catalog/file changes or silently widen schema32 to fixture33.

rows.given: Directory current/read, local selection generate/read/recovery or selected ADOPT uses ordinary current P3/P4.
rows.must: All required source consumers must share the original ordinary managed transaction and its final callbacks while retaining original catalog validation before/after. LocalDemoCatalog.read_connection/connection, local_demo_selections and selected ADOPT must not produce a plain unregistered connection for guard_current. Validate actual parent and final current authority after waits without recursive/double lifecycle loops.
rows.must_not: Do not suppress guard_current failure, skip _checks, acquire apparent authority from a preliminary locator read or claim physical commit atomicity. Existing guard_current is consumer-scoped; unrelated P1/P2-only results must not inherit step expiry.

rows.given: A current parent and selected instance participants/resources are evaluated.
rows.must: Bind exact existing successful synthetic Run/Case/preparation/current service/current reviewer and same park/org. Reuse existing demo current_mapping_states for actual directory/selection/adoption and active business binding, plus original OrdinaryCaseStep participant/current Grant checks. Selected executor/resources must match actual accepted executor and linked resource outputs; configured references alone do not prove work happened.
rows.must_not: Do not invent assignment/authority, trust body org/marker alone, accept another pack/Case/executor or bypass any active/inactive Run assignment or Native protocol/activation trace. Ordinary executor still has no Run/wholeCase/wholePlan/P5 collection access.

rows.given: Explicit OFFER/ACCEPT/manual SUBMIT/owner ACK and P3/P4/P5 are performed.
rows.must: Reuse original transactions, fingerprint/provenance/event checks/current material/resource checks, participant xmin generations and original first OFFER UUID/absolute deadline at most300s. Retain one-offer/no renewal, current authority rechecks and original final wait checks. New mode changes admission wiring only.
rows.must_not: No algorithm clone, automatic VERIFY/ADOPT/receipt/close, fixture-finish, new issuer/session expiry, deadline reset or ABA resurrection. Old ISOLATED and unmarked legacy business records remain separate; existing Native/Run denials remain denials.

rows.given: Historical owner read, stopping WITHDRAW, expired/withdrawn step or revoked execution permission.
rows.must: Preserve original history READ/PREPARE and required resource READ vs write EXECUTE separation; original stopping WITHDRAW cannot depend on a revoked old target or current materials/live step. Keep mandatory demo input/object/parent binding checks distinct from all-active mapping/EXECUTE checks. Legitimate step history does not become current output or extend deadline.
rows.must_not: Do not indiscriminately run full catalog.snapshot/current_mapping_states on every history context if that would require owner EXECUTE or target current action authority; no read-to-write privilege, expired action revival or native fallback.

rows.given: The registered local demo selection candidate and adoption proof are created or cold-read.
rows.must: Reuse original parse/enumeration/minimality/rebuild/current source hash/frozen registry/provenance/explicit consume and adoption algorithms. Only UNIQUE one-solution NO_MODEL can adopt through the original explicit candidate request/hash/key. Preserve LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_DEMO_NO_MODEL_V1, model=null/provider_enabled=false/real_model_calls=0 and business_publication=false/new_grants=false.
rows.must_not: Do not reinterpret demo contracts as reviewed TemplateEngine releases/Approval/model proof, manufacture fake transport/usage, add publication/journal kinds or silently adopt partial/multiple/unknown/expired/stale candidates.

rows.given: Selected plan proceeds through P1-P5 to original goal-results/TXT.
rows.must: Keep original human P1 verification, real original local P2 resources/link, own acceptance P3, actual manual receipt+ACK P4, explicit REVALIDATE/CLOSE/VERIFY P5 and conservative original record result/pack. Preserve READY semantics, cycle/history/REOPEN and original recovery fingerprints/proof limitations. Current selected participant/resource bindings must remain checked; no external booking/fulfillment/goal-complete claim.
rows.must_not: No new workflow, bypass of owner VERIFY/prior dependencies/material sources, source proof from status alone, or fake signature/full REOPEN optional-SHA reconstruction. Original local close stays WAITING_CONFIRMATION/case_goal_completed=false.

rows.given: API/worker stop and physically restart against the same installed synthetic DB and existing config.
rows.must: API and worker use the same explicit factory semantics. Each process may recreate its own exact dependency graph, internally sharing its same Store/catalog, while revalidating durable input hashes/catalog generations and original UUID/deadline/proof. Cold GET/recovery never sends unknown old writes. New tests, if parent executes them, remain separate from static review.
rows.must_not: No cross-process object identity assertion, fixture nonce/process lifetime authority, implicit setup/seed/regrant/reoffer/replay, adoption of unknown PID/lock, retry of prior risk-marked dynamic window or independent dynamic execution. Windows/browser/formal AT35/real business/project completeness remain unverified.
